source: Measured from the user's 11.8 s reference reel (720x1280, 24 fps, 6 shots). Style reference only; no footage is reused.
look: photoreal cinematic CGI of an Indian epic, golden-hour backlight, sun low in frame, volumetric haze and dust, warm rim light on skin and metal, shallow depth of field, anamorphic flare, heroic scale
exposure: deep crushed blacks (5th-percentile luma ~11/255), bright creamy highlights (95th ~222), mid-tones low (~82)
motion: slow, smooth, stabilised camera moves (push-in, slow tracking, rack focus); one larger move per reel; no shaky cam
shot_scale_pattern: hero close-up of a face looking up, crown/ornament detail
wide procession or army against the sun
macro insert of a small living detail backlit by the sun
low-angle ground detail: feet, shadows, dust
close detail of a prop in motion: bow, cloth, banner
return to the wide establishing shot
transitions: hard cuts on the beat; occasional quick dip to white on a big reveal
special_framing: some widescreen shots are laid sideways (rotated 90 degrees) inside the vertical frame; use sparingly
text: almost none: channel handle and music credit only; at most one short verse line
audio: music-led, integrated loudness -14.3 LUFS, loudness range 5.1 LU; voice presence unverified
negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, flat lighting, oversaturated neon, text, watermark, logo, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, gore, blood, sexualised, comedic, modern objects in epic scenes
